name: Jana Montanari
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026 under the new rule: still out. Her own site (montanari-coaching.de, robots.txt allows us; Hochheim, Germany) is now mainly a menopause health and nutrition site: the home page leads with perimenopause health tips 'with a focus on natural remedies' and 'biohacking for women over 40', and its articles are on liver-friendly diet, omega-3, vitamin D3/K2, medicinal mushrooms, ashwagandha and other supplements (diet and nutrition content is always out). Her meditation page claims meditation lowers blood pressure, strengthens the immune system and eases depression (disease claims), and her about page offers practice as a Heilpraktikerin (Psychotherapie) for burnout, depression and anxiety alongside homeopathy (clinical). What remains is one coaching page (spiritual coaching, ThetaHealing, Akashic readings) and a podcast, too little for a listing. Contact exists (jana@montanari-coaching.de).
